proof: A hands-on approach, tailored to your needs.
services: Support through difficult family changes, with practical guidance and court representation when needed.

Agreements: pre-nuptial, cohabitation and separation · Divorce · Parenting and child support · Spousal support · Family property division · Adult interdependent partner matters · Mobility and guardianship applications · Emergency protection and restraining orders
Personalized, cost-effective legal services for residential and commercial property matters.
Residential purchases and sales · Mortgage refinancing · Title transfers · Due diligence and purchase agreements · Land-title documentation
Plan for the future and get thoughtful help administering an estate.
Wills · Powers of attorney · Personal directives · Estate planning · Probate applications · Grants of administration · Adult trusteeship and guardianship
Advice and representation for workplace issues throughout Alberta.

Wrongful dismissal and termination · Severance review and negotiation · Constructive dismissal · Workplace harassment and discrimination · Employment standards · Contracts · Human rights claims · Workplace investigations · Labour relations and occupational health and safety
teamText: The firm describes a hands-on approach to each matter—working with clients to find a practical strategy for their needs.
contactText: Tell us a little about the matter you are facing. The office can direct your inquiry to the right team.
